config.adbPath.description: Path to the adb executable or its directory. Leave empty to use the ADB environment variable, then platform-tools under ANDROID_HOME / ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, then PATH.
config.adbPath.markdownDescription: Path to the adb executable or its directory. Leave empty to use the `ADB` environment variable, then `platform-tools` under `ANDROID_HOME` / `ANDROID_SDK_ROOT`, then `PATH`. You can also [choose the adb file](command:adbWifi.selectAdbPath).
config.serverPort.description: ADB server port. Default 5038 avoids conflicts with other tools using 5037.
config.refreshInterval.description: Interval (ms) for refreshing devices and mDNS state while idle. QR pairing and failures adjust it automatically.
